counterfactual_missing_items: a near-occlusive embolus in the left pulmonary artery
decisive_items: a 17 × 9 cm mixed solid and cystic mass occupying the right hepatic lobe
response.rationale: R1 identifies the primary hepatic mass, which is the most likely underlying diagnosis in a child with this presentation, while R4 captures the secondary embolic complications. R1 is more diagnostically specific and etiologically primary.

rejected.why: Abdominal compartment syndrome is a concern but not the primary diagnosis; it is a complication of the mass.
Pulmonary embolism is a complication, not the underlying cause.
IVC thrombosis is a complication, not the primary diagnosis.
C1 is an append-only completion of R4, redundant and less primary than R1.
